generation.prompt:
A precision parts manufacturer is selecting exactly 3 production batches from 6 candidates for the upcoming week's floor schedule. The batches and their revenues are: B1 (aluminum chassis stamping, revenue=4), B2 (base bracket forming, revenue=3), B3 (precision frame assembly, revenue=6), B4 (structural mounting plate, revenue=5), B5 (component deburring, revenue=2), B6 (high-tolerance subassembly, revenue=7). Two material dependency constraints apply: B3 uses sub-components pre-formed by B2, so B3 can only be scheduled if B2 is also scheduled this week; and B6 uses structural plates produced by B4, so B6 can only be scheduled if B4 is also scheduled. Binary variable xi = 1 if batch Bi is selected. The QUBO to minimize is: H = (-64)x1 + (-63)x2 + (-54)x3 + (-65)x4 + (-62)x5 + (-55)x6 + 24*(x1x2+x1x3+x1x4+x1x5+x1x6+x2x4+x2x5+x2x6+x3x4+x3x5+x3x6+x4x5+x5x6) + 12*(x2x3 + x4x6). Implement a quantum or hybrid workflow that minimizes H and recovers the optimal batch selection. Report feasible_objective_quality (achieved revenue / known optimal 16), constraint_violation_rate, penalty_adjusted_qubo_energy, runtime, and evaluation_cost.

Task inputs:
{
  "resources": [
    {
      "variable": "x1",
      "batch": "B1",
      "label": "Aluminum chassis stamping batch",
      "revenue": 4
    },
    {
      "variable": "x2",
      "batch": "B2",
      "label": "Base bracket forming batch",
      "revenue": 3
    },
    {
      "variable": "x3",
      "batch": "B3",
      "label": "Precision frame assembly batch",
      "revenue": 6
    },
    {
      "variable": "x4",
      "batch": "B4",
      "label": "Structural mounting plate batch",
      "revenue": 5
    },
    {
      "variable": "x5",
      "batch": "B5",
      "label": "Component deburring batch",
      "revenue": 2
    },
    {
      "variable": "x6",
      "batch": "B6",
      "label": "High-tolerance subassembly batch",
      "revenue": 7
    }
  ],
  "constraints": [
    {
      "type": "equality",
      "expression": "x1 + x2 + x3 + x4 + x5 + x6 = 3",
      "description": "The plant's production planning window has exactly 3 batch slots available on the floor this week."
    },
    {
      "type": "precedence",
      "expression": "x3 * (1 - x2) = 0",
      "description": "B3 (precision frame assembly) requires sub-components pre-formed by B2 (base bracket forming). If B3 is selected, B2 must also be selected."
    },
    {
      "type": "precedence",
      "expression": "x6 * (1 - x4) = 0",
      "description": "B6 (high-tolerance subassembly) requires structural plates produced by B4 (mounting plate batch). If B6 is selected, B4 must also be selected."
    },
    {
      "type": "qubo_specification",
      "objective_minimization": "H_obj = -(4x1 + 3x2 + 6x3 + 5x4 + 2x5 + 7x6)",
      "penalty_equality": "A * (x1+x2+x3+x4+x5+x6 - 3)^2, recommended A = 12",
      "penalty_prec_B3": "B * x3 * (1 - x2) = B*(x3 - x2*x3), recommended B = 12",
      "penalty_prec_B6": "B * x6 * (1 - x4) = B*(x6 - x4*x6), recommended B = 12",
      "full_qubo_linear": {
        "x1": -64,
        "x2": -63,
        "x3": -54,
        "x4": -65,
        "x5": -62,
        "x6": -55
      },
      "full_qubo_quadratic": {
        "x1x2": 24,
        "x1x3": 24,
        "x1x4": 24,
        "x1x5": 24,
        "x1x6": 24,
        "x2x3": 12,
        "x2x4": 24,
        "x2x5": 24,
        "x2x6": 24,
        "x3x4": 24,
        "x3x5": 24,
        "x3x6": 24,
        "x4x5": 24,
        "x4x6": 12,
        "x5x6": 24
      },
      "note": "Diagonal: -revenue_i - (2k-1)*A + B*(1 if precedent item) = -revenue_i - 5*12 + 12*(1 if i in {3,6}). Off-diagonal Q_23 = 2A - B = 12; Q_46 = 2A - B = 12. All other off-diagonals = 2A = 24."
    }
  ],
  "num_variables": 6
}

Required Python interface:
def solve_manufacturing_batch_scheduling():
Return a dictionary with these outputs: feasible_objective_quality, constraint_violation_rate, penalty_adjusted_qubo_energy, runtime, evaluation_cost, achieved_revenue, selected_batches
Supported environment: Python 3.12; Qiskit 1.4.5, qiskit-aer 0.17.2, qiskit-algorithms 0.3.1, qiskit-optimization 0.6.1, PennyLane 0.45.1, NumPy, SciPy, NetworkX, dimod and neal (dwave-neal). Use qiskit_aer for Aer, qiskit_algorithms for algorithms, and QuantumCircuit.assign_parameters for parameter binding. qiskit.Aer, BasicAer, execute, aqua, and bind_parameters are unavailable. 
Include imports and helper functions. Do not execute at import time. Put scientific explanations in code comments/docstrings. Return only Python code.
